name: elastic-stretch-text
title: Elastic Stretch Text
description: Glyphs stretch horizontally away from the pointer like a material with tension, using scaleX with an overshoot curve on release; the stretch is per-glyph so the word deforms, not just moves.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Geometric
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Pointer Deform: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
